import RNA, random, sys
t='.(((.(((...(((.(((...))).(((....))).)))...(((.(((....))).(((...))).)))...(((.(((....))).(((...))).)))...))).(((...))).))).'
n=len(t)
pairs={}
stack=[]
for i,c in enumerate(t):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pairs[j]=i
        pairs[i]=j

def score(ss):
    # bp distance to target
    st=[]
    fp={}
    for i,c in enumerate(ss):
        if c=='(':
            st.append(i)
        elif c==')':
            j=st.pop()
            fp[j]=i
            fp[i]=j
    tp=set((i,j) for i,j in pairs.items() if i<j)
    fset=set((i,j) for i,j in fp.items() if i<j)
    return len(tp^fset)

# seed
seed="AGGGAGGGAAAGGGAGGGGAACCCAGGGGAAACCCACCCAAAGGGAGGGGAAACCCAGGGGAACCCACCCAAAGGGAGGGGAAACCCAGGGGAACCCACCCAAACCCAGGGGAACCCACCCA"

best=seed
fc=RNA.fold_compound(best)
ss,mfe=fc.mfe()
bd=score(ss)
print("seed bd",bd)

alphabet='ACGU'
import time
deadline=time.time()+150
cur=list(best)
cur_bd=bd
rng=random.Random(42)
it=0
while time.time()<deadline and cur_bd>0:
    it+=1
    # pick random position, mutate
    i=rng.randrange(n)
    old=cur[i]
    new=rng.choice(alphabet.replace(old,''))
    cand=cur[:]
    cand[i]=new
    cs=''.join(cand)
    fc2=RNA.fold_compound(cs)
    s2,_=fc2.mfe()
    bd2=score(s2)
    if bd2<=cur_bd:
        cur=cand
        cur_bd=bd2
        if bd2<bd:
            bd=bd2
            best=cs
    if it%2000==0:
        print(it,cur_bd,best[:30],flush=True)
print("final bd",bd)
print("BEST",best)
fc=RNA.fold_compound(best)
ss,_=fc.mfe()
print("verify match",ss==t)
